task.description: Steps 0.5+1: Confirm GH-714 open. Create/update docs/issues/ISS-0673.json status IN_PROGRESS. Read docs/anti-patterns.md Database/Migrations section for ISS-0185 context. Run python tools/lint_dual_schema_table_names.py against the live bpm_test database to confirm the 10 tables are still duplicated. Identify which migrations (in 1140-1151 range or GBL-13x) create these tables without a schema scope guard by reading those migration files. Document root_cause.details: exact migration(s) causing the issue, why they lack a scope guard.

result.summary: Step 0.5+1 complete. GH-714 confirmed OPEN. ISS-0673.json created (status=IN_PROGRESS) with full root-cause diagnosis. Linter confirms 8 duplicated tables (events_ephemeral, events_ephemeral_2026_08/09/10, plat_correlation_cursor, plat_effect_completion, plat_partition_catalog, plat_partition_maintenance_run_log). Root cause: migrations 1145, 1146, 1148, 1149 (ORD/PAR batch, post-GBL-141) create tables with unqualified top-level DDL and no scope guard, causing the migration runner to create them in every schema pass. ISS-0185-family recurrence.

issues.description: Issue title states 10 duplicated tables; linter confirms 8. Discrepancy: event_payload_store public shadow already dropped by GBL-141; plat_event_idempotency already guarded in 1147. Authoritative count is 8 per live linter run.

result.next_action: Route to BACKEND-DEV (WF-03 Step 2) to implement GBL-142 drop migration and patch source migrations 1145/1146/1148/1149 with scope guards
